description: This file implements lazy loading of Android runtime functions, including JNI environment retrieval, IBinder conversions, and parcel handling, using dynamic library loading and function pointers.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Dynamically loads the libandroid_runtime.so library and retrieves function pointers for JNI and binder functions.

methods.name: getJNIEnv
methods.description: Returns the JNI environment pointer, loading the function if necessary.

methods.name: ibinderForJavaObject
methods.description: Converts a Java object to an IBinder pointer, loading the function if necessary.

methods.name: javaObjectForIBinder
methods.description: Converts an IBinder to a Java object, loading the function if necessary.

methods.name: parcelForJavaObject
methods.description: Converts a Java object to a Parcel pointer, loading the function if necessary.
